title: Model-version create denies a nonexistent source run/model with 403, not the store's 404
answers: creating a model version with a missing run id returns 404 and reveals which runs exist
why does model version create return Permission denied for an unknown source id
existence oracle on model registry source run id
nonexistent runId or modelId returns different error than forbidden
body:
Invariant: in the model-version create source check, a nonexistent runId / run_id / modelId / model_id is denied with 403 "Permission denied", the same as an existing source the caller cannot read.
Enforced by: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_can_read_model_version_source, which catches MlflowException with error code RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST and returns False. Other MlflowExceptions are re-raised.
What breaks if skipped: the store's 404 for a missing id differs from the 403 for an existing but unreadable id, so callers can probe which run and logged-model ids exist.
Constraints: only RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST is swallowed. Do not add a broader except, because that would hide real store failures. The guard must wrap both the run and model permission lookups.
Applies: source-read checks in validate_can_create_model_version and any other basic-auth check that resolves a caller-supplied run or model id before the handler does.
applies: Basic-auth source-id permission checks for model version creation in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py.
says: Creating a model version from an invalid run gives permission denied instead of not found.
Missing source runs return not found errors that reveal which runs actually exist to unauthorized users.
Registering a model version with an unknown source run should show a permission denied error.
The system leaks run existence when users register model versions from nonexistent experiment runs.
search: In mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_can_read_model_version_source, nonexistent runId, run_id, modelId, or model_id sources are denied with 403 Permission denied instead of 404 to avoid existence oracles. The guard catches MlflowException with error code RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST and returns False, while other exceptions are re-raised. Applies to source-read permission checks in validate_can_create_model_version and basic-auth checks resolving caller-supplied run or model IDs before the handler.
